row.evidence: Meta's Workplace page now says "Workplace has closed as of May 2026.", so the product (and its SCIM 2.0 API at scim.workplace.com) can no longer be bought or provisioned.
row.notes: Discontinued: Workplace from Meta (formerly Workplace by Facebook) closed in May 2026; workplace.com and its pricing page redirect to a closure notice at meta.com/workplace. Status 'none' only because nothing is sold today; the rules do not cover discontinued products, so this row should probably be dropped or flagged at merge. Before closure, Meta's still-online developer docs documented a SCIM 2.0 API (base https://scim.workplace.com/, bearer token from a custom integration app with the Manage Accounts permission; create, PUT/PATCH, deactivate via active=false which ends sessions immediately; DELETE also only deactivates; Groups mapped to People Sets) plus Graph API account management, and Okta OIN and Entra gallery provisioning apps are still listed. No plan or price for SCIM could be cited because the pricing pages are gone.

auth.token_source: Admin Panel > Integrations: create a custom integration app with the Manage Accounts permission (System Administrator only)

deprovision.data_retained: Account is deactivated, not deleted; DELETE on /Users also only deactivates.

custom.how: Facebook extensions: accountstatusdetails (invited, claimed, claimLink, accessCode, canDelete), authmethod (authMethod), frontline (frontline, hasAccess), starttermdates (startDate, termDate), and customprofilefields for Additional Profile Fields.

limitations.text: Group responses may be truncated to 10,000 members.
A User-Agent header is mandatory on every SCIM request.
Creating an account starts invitation emails unless 'Send invites when accounts are created' is disabled.
Workplace closed in May 2026; none of this is usable today.

scim.notes: Product closed (May 2026), so SCIM is no longer available. The fields below record what Meta's developer docs (still online) documented before closure; SCIM 1.1 (www.workplace.com/scim/v1) was deprecated earlier.

user_api.notes: Graph API account management endpoints (read, create, modify, delete users) were documented, but the product closed in May 2026. Endpoint paths not recorded.

okta.notes: OIN 'Workplace by Facebook' page (last updated Aug 7 2025) is still listed with SAML and SCIM provisioning; the target service closed in May 2026.

entra.notes: Entra provisioning tutorial still published; the target service closed in May 2026.
